sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Laboratory"."ID" AS e, "Patient"."SEX" AS g, AVG((CAST(("Laboratory"."IGM" - "Laboratory"."GLU") AS REAL) / "Laboratory"."GLU")) AS m1, COUNT(*) AS m2 FROM "Laboratory" JOIN "Patient" ON "Patient"."ID" = "Laboratory"."ID"  GROUP BY "Laboratory"."ID", "Patient"."SEX"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m2") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, (CAST("s1"."m2" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL) SELECT "s3"."g" AS g, AVG("s3"."m1") AS m1, SUM("s3"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s3"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s3" GROUP BY "s3"."g"
quantities: Laboratory.relative difference of immunoglobulin M level from blood glucose concentration
why: (immunoglobulin M level - blood glucose concentration) / blood glucose concentration: the relative difference of two quantities in mg/dL
average of relative difference of immunoglobulin M level from blood glucose concentration per Patient within Patient.SEX
share of the all total of number of Laboratory records (all level)
coarsen to g: AVG (averaged), SUM (additive), AVG (averaged)
